evidence: Cic. Att. 8.13.1: librāriī manus, a copyist’s hand (Lewis & Short s.v. manus)

terms.gloss: one’s own handwriting; a handwritten document
evidence: Cic. Fam. 2.13.3: extrēma pāgella pupugit mē tuō chīrographō (Lewis & Short)
